title: NCR Atleos selected by Bank Pekao S.A. to modernize card payment processing infrastructure with Authentic switch
summary: NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) (“Atleos”), a leader in expanding self-service financial access for financial institutions, retailers and consumers, today announced that Bank Pekao S.A., one of the largest financial institutions in Central and Eastern Europe, has selected the Atleos Authentic™ payment switching platform as part of its card payment processing infrastructure modernization strategy.
body_markdown:
ATLANTA --[NCR Atleos](https://www.ncratleos.com/) Corporation (NYSE: NATL) (“Atleos”), a leader in expanding self-service financial access for financial institutions, retailers and consumers, today announced that Bank Pekao S.A., one of the largest financial institutions in Central and Eastern Europe, has selected the Atleos Authentic™ payment switching platform as part of its card payment processing infrastructure modernization strategy.


Under the agreement, Atleos will provide its Authentic switch platform to support Bank Pekao S.A. card payment processing operations and future innovation objectives. The implementation is expected to help modernize the bank’s card payments infrastructure while providing a scalable foundation for future growth and evolving customer needs.


"As one of the leading financial institutions in Central and Eastern Europe, we are continuously investing in technologies that enhance efficiency, resilience and innovation across our operations," said Maciej Jopyk, CIO/head of IT, Bank Pekao S.A. "After a comprehensive evaluation process, we selected the Authentic platform because of its proven capabilities, flexibility and strong track record supporting payment modernization initiatives at financial institutions around the world. We look forward to working with Atleos to advance our infrastructure strategy and support future growth."


Bank Pekao S.A. joins other financial institutions that rely on the Authentic platform to power mission-critical card payment processing environments. The platform enables institutions to modernize legacy infrastructures, streamline operations and accelerate the introduction of new payment services.


"This agreement with Bank Pekao S.A. represents an important milestone for Atleos and further demonstrates Authentic leadership in helping financial institutions modernize complex payments environments," said Bartłomiej Śliwa, Area Vice President, Central and Eastern Europe, Global Sales, for Atleos. "As one of the most respected banking brands in the region, Bank Pekao S.A. provides an outstanding example for organizations pursuing similar transformation initiatives. We are proud to support the bank's modernization strategy and look forward to delivering a successful implementation that creates long-term value."


The agreement further strengthens Atleos presence in Central and Eastern Europe and highlights growing demand among financial institutions seeking to replace legacy payment processing systems with modern, scalable platforms designed to support future innovation.
